evidence.reason: Left edit changes the third argument to reminders.evaluate from "work" to "benchmark" and drops reminders.initialize(), altering the contract relied on by scheduledDelay callers and the test assert.ok(await scheduledDelay(40) > 0).

Right edit rebinds evaluate from reminderDelay to reminderDelayV2, changing the implementation used by both scheduledDelay and reminderQuote without evidence that reminderDelayV2 preserves the "work" calendar semantics or initialize() requirement.
reminderQuote calls evaluate(minutes, multiplier, calendar) and the test asserts reminderQuote(30, 0.1, "work").amount > 0, so the evaluate swap affects this caller's behavior.
Tests assert evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0 and assert.throws(() => evaluate(-1, 0.1, "work"), RangeError), establishing behavior jointly relied on before the edits.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动叠加后，evaluate 的实现被替换且调用参数从 "work" 改为 "benchmark"，现有测试与调用方仍依赖 "work" 语义，合并行为存在不确定性。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/reminders.ts 的 evaluate 维护者确认 reminderDelayV2 是否兼容 "work" 日历与 initialize() 前置条件；若不兼容，应改回 reminderDelay 或让 src/scheduling.ts 的 scheduledDelay 恢复传入 "work" 并保留 reminders.initialize()。
